checked_classes: Scope: bounded independent review of The Boss source freeze 2a508b433db5dea80073b46fee34b8c549043056, build/release-operation-2.2.38/operation.json, build/uar-payload-refresh-ac097043.json and landing commit aa29f5bd636a507f21d3290f3d54e4d6826dcbae. Its selected archive hashes match the payload receipt. The mini source metadata and frozen Git submodule entry both bind 52a84e7d19f3ffdae0b58bd1732a853abd06e748. Older payload provenance is explicitly retained for out-of-scope platforms.

The operation receipt reports Developer ID signing and separate packaged/installed signature results. The UAR prompt screenshot shows the exact UAR_AC097_READY response and completed state; the correlation screenshot matches receipt run 6592dbb1-0887-47f1-a5be-6d14f1462ebe and workspace da769885-e227-49ad-a407-fb337e4dab60. These support the affected operation; they do not prove a broader negative authority/effect matrix. Exact owner, scope and host-privilege claims remain tied to the existing separate two-file UAR source review.

Publication and acceptance boundaries: selected native UAR payload production/publication/import is reported independently of application installer publication. operation.json leaves application publication in_progress, website pending, Mac operator acceptance pending and Windows installed operation pending. This review does not certify current workflow state, public installer bytes, landing deployment or rendered download links; the lead owns those separate receipts. The earlier accepted 2.2.32 candidate is preserved.

Release copy: frozen bilingual 2.2.38 history discloses UAR repair, mini refresh, selected platforms, deferred notarization and explicit legacy ownership migration/reconfiguration limits. Landing commit aa29f5b changes only the retained-installer sentence and its CLAUDE.md description. Earlier release: v{installer.version} names the actual retained version without implying future publication. Existing source keeps the per-installer version in accessible download labels. No actionable writing findings in that scoped sentence; source inspection is sufficient for the copy conclusion and does not certify rendered UI.

Historical accounting: the operation receipt preserves 61/61 code tasks, 20/20 changes, 43/61 terminal qualification with its skipped-duplicate distinction and retired Cadence with 17 deliveries. The reviewed final freeze and landing-copy edits do not reset those records or turn source completion into qualification.

Review limits: read-only Git/source/receipt/log inspection and saved-image inspection only. No tests, builds, compiler commands, current UI operations, commits, pushes, deployments or publication mutations were performed. The only file written by this review is final-source-review.json. PASS means no concrete defect found in the inspected final inputs, not release publication or operator acceptance.
